title: Definitions.
officialText: As used in this chapter, the term "certification of correction" means the paper or electronic document filed with the department of buildings or the department of housing preservation and development by a property owner or managing agent to affirm that the violating conditions cited on a notice of violation have been corrected within the required timeframe.
